hardcoded_values_found.description: Number of hardcoded hex/rgb/hsl values found. Must be 0 for a passing audit.

org_specific_tokens_found.description: Number of org-specific token names found. Must be 0 for a passing audit.

violations_fixed.description: List of violations that were corrected in the spec.

location.description: Where in UI_Spec.md the violation was found.

original_value.description: The hardcoded or org-specific value that was replaced.

corrected_value.description: The generic token that replaced it.

token_gaps.description: Visual properties that needed a token not in the authorized set. Each requires Tech Lead escalation.

new_component_proposals_justified.description: True if all new component proposals have explicit justification or were removed (replaced with existing components).

components_reuse_opportunities.description: New component proposals that were replaced with existing components.

verdict.description: PASS: zero violations, all reuse checked. PASS_WITH_TOKEN_GAPS: violations fixed but token gaps escalated. FAIL: violations remain unfixed.
